html:
SMTO-OUT-0002 — This Task can't be summarized yet

GUID: 43526db9-c265-4a5c-9452-ea13b1cd2797
Slug: summary-evidence-unavailable
Domain: OUT · Subsystem: out

What happened

  • SMTO can only summarize a Task after it has finished and saved its results. This Task is still running, is waiting for you, or has no saved results, or its summary came back empty.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the Task's reply. If it's still working, or waiting for your approval or answer, deal with that and let it finish. A summary describes finished work, so SMTO won't write one while the Task can still change.
  2. Once it has finished, reload the page and check whether a summary already shows under the reply. Your earlier request may already have produced a summary, so asking again may not be needed.
  3. Only if no summary shows and the Summarize button is offered, select Summarize once. Summarizing only reads the saved results; it doesn't run any of the Task's actions again.

What success looks like

  • A summary appears under the Task's reply.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened, such as a summary already showing under the reply, before selecting Summarize again. If it still fails, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't run the Task again just to get a summary; that would repeat its actions.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Summary generation refused because the native run is not in a terminal state with stored execution evidence, or the resulting summary text was empty or whitespace only.

What this means

  • Summary generation finds no eligible terminal state with execution evidence, or its structured result contains only empty/whitespace summary text. Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Summary generation finds no eligible terminal state with execution evidence, or its structured result contains only empty/whitespace summary text.

How to diagnose it

  • Separate eligibility failure from an empty model-produced summary and inspect existing terminal receipts.

How to fix it

  • Wait for the run's authoritative terminal status (completed, answered, partial, blocked, failed, cancelled or interrupted), then read GET /api/agent/native/<request_id>/summary to check whether a summary already exists before POSTing again. If summary generation returned nothing, inspect the retained trace; do not rerun completed operations to obtain a summary.
  • Wait for a task’s authoritative terminal result and use its retained evidence. If summary generation returned nothing, inspect the retained trace; do not rerun completed operations to obtain a summary.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • An eligible task produces a nonempty valid summary without repeating its operations.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
